summary: Boise NF hike-in lookout with a 1917 camp, a cupola dated 1922 or 1933, and a flat cab dated 1962 or 1965; standing, staffed in season.

access.note: Hike-in site. The Trout Creek / Thunderbolt Trailhead is signed and gated; the Forest Service advises checking the Motor Vehicle Use Map. Current season not confirmed.

visit.trail_note: Hike-in; the Forest Service Trout Creek / Thunderbolt Trailhead area serves the lookout, and a campground sits near that trailhead.

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Boise National Forest

events.note: Camp at the summit, the first use of the site for a lookout.
Log cabin with cupola, per Forest Lookouts. Other sources date the cupola house to 1933.
D-6 cupola structure (NHLR); log cabin with cupola (firelookout.com).
Current two-story R-6 flat cab. The NHLR description allows 1965 instead.
Per Forest Lookouts, an R-6 flat-roof cab on a 10-foot base replaced the old cupola house.
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register, October 3, 2020.

evidence.quote: US Forest Service - Boise National Forest

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The current cab is dated 1962 by firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the NHLR Built field, but the NHLR description allows 1962 or 1965 and Forest Lookouts dates a replacement cab to 1965. The story reports both.
NHLR and firelookout.com date the cupola house to 1933; Forest Lookouts dates the log cabin with cupola to 1922. Both are kept in events.
NHLR gives 8,656 ft (2,638 m); firelookout.com gives 8652 ft. The story uses the NHLR figure.

The NHLR (fire season), firelookout.com (every summer) and Idaho Fire Lookouts (hike-in staffed) describe staffing differently, and none is dated. The story gives the range and does not claim a current season.

notes_for_editor: Build dates conflict: 1962 (NHLR field, firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts) versus 1962 or 1965 (NHLR description) and 1965 (Forest Lookouts). Cupola date 1933 versus 1922. Elevation 8,656 ft (NHLR) versus 8652 ft (firelookout.com). Staffing is seasonal and undated. No notable fire was recorded in the pages read. The brief's events for 1962 and the 2020 registration are supported. One search snippet, not read, described a jeep trail to within about 5 miles of the summit; it is unverified and not used. Current 2026 access was not confirmed.
